description: Download the file associated with a Document Revision

parameters.name: no_redirect
parameters.description: If this query parameter is set to true, the response will be an object containing the download URL.

200.description: If the `no_redirect=true` query parameter is provided, the response will be an object containing the download URL.

400.description:
document_revision_id is not a valid ULID.

Possible reason codes:
- INVALID_PROPERTY

404.description:
The document revision was not found.

Possible reason codes:
- NOT_FOUND

410.description:
Document metadata is present but the file data could not be found

Possible reason codes:
- GONE
